gui.gnomos.trade_prompt: Want to barter? Pick one of my deals.
gui.gnomos.trade_fail: Oops, you don't have enough for that deal.
message.gnomos.not_enough: You don't have enough for that deal
dialogue.gnomos.hat: Oh, what a fine hat! You're one of us. I'll give you a discount!
dialogue.gnomos.farmer.greet.1: Hello, big one! Mind my carrots.
dialogue.gnomos.farmer.greet.2: Good morning. The wheat is growing wonderfully today.
dialogue.gnomos.farmer.work.1: Sow, water, harvest... and start over. Best job in the world!
dialogue.gnomos.farmer.work.2: A good harvest needs water nearby and lots of patience.
dialogue.gnomos.farmer.advice.1: Plant carrots next to water and you'll never go hungry.
dialogue.gnomos.farmer.advice.2: Bone meal works wonders on seeds.
dialogue.gnomos.farmer.rumors.1: They say the forest gnomes bake a heavenly bread.
dialogue.gnomos.farmer.rumors.2: Last night I saw strange lights in the hedges. Probably glowcaps.
dialogue.gnomos.miner.greet.1: Hey, mind your head! Well, you're tall; I'm not.
dialogue.gnomos.miner.greet.2: Looking for coal? No cave-ins today, good sign!
dialogue.gnomos.miner.work.1: We dig stone from sunrise. My beard is dust, not age.
dialogue.gnomos.miner.work.2: There's plenty of iron down the shaft, but bring a light.
dialogue.gnomos.miner.advice.1: Always carry torches. And never dig straight down.
dialogue.gnomos.miner.advice.2: If you hear water or lava, stop and think first.
dialogue.gnomos.miner.rumors.1: They say the deepest cave is full of crystals.
dialogue.gnomos.miner.rumors.2: My cousin saw an ancient city under the mountain.
dialogue.gnomos.blacksmith.greet.1: Welcome to the forge! Look, but don't touch what's hot.
dialogue.gnomos.blacksmith.greet.2: Clang, clang... oh, hello! I was finishing a piece.
dialogue.gnomos.blacksmith.work.1: Good iron and lots of love make the best tools.
dialogue.gnomos.blacksmith.work.2: The anvil is my best friend; it never complains.
dialogue.gnomos.blacksmith.advice.1: Repair your tools before they break. Trust me.
dialogue.gnomos.blacksmith.advice.2: One good strike beats ten clumsy ones.
dialogue.gnomos.blacksmith.rumors.1: They say a gnome forged a sword so fine it cuts fog.
dialogue.gnomos.blacksmith.rumors.2: The miner brings me iron every week. Thanks to him I have work!
dialogue.gnomos.forager.greet.1: Shhh! You're stepping on a shy mushroom. Oh, hello.
dialogue.gnomos.forager.greet.2: Hello, hello. Want to see my basket? Full of mushrooms today.
dialogue.gnomos.forager.work.1: I gather berries and mushrooms all over the forest. Always something new!
dialogue.gnomos.forager.work.2: Glowcaps only grow where it's shady and damp.
dialogue.gnomos.forager.advice.1: Never eat mushrooms you don't know. The red spotted ones? Don't even look!
dialogue.gnomos.forager.advice.2: If you get lost at night, follow the glow of the glowcaps.
dialogue.gnomos.forager.rumors.1: They say mushrooms talk at night. I only hear the wind.
dialogue.gnomos.forager.rumors.2: There's a secret glade where the biggest mushrooms grow.
dialogue.gnomos.elder.greet.1: Welcome, traveler. We rarely get such tall visitors.
dialogue.gnomos.elder.greet.2: Ah, a gentle giant. Come in; the fire is lit.
dialogue.gnomos.elder.work.1: I look after the village and its stories. Can't lose either one.
dialogue.gnomos.elder.work.2: Keeping peace among gnomes is harder than chipping granite.
dialogue.gnomos.elder.advice.1: Be kind to the little ones and they'll be great allies.
dialogue.gnomos.elder.advice.2: Whoever wears a gnome hat is always welcome in our homes.
dialogue.gnomos.elder.rumors.1: They say there were gnome villages in every biome, each with its secrets.
dialogue.gnomos.elder.rumors.2: My grandparents said gnomes were born from a magic mushroom.
